source: Original patterns written with the hook-writer method (mechanism-first, gap + truth). No third-party lines, no brand or character references.
rules: A hook opens a gap the next shot closes; the film must pay it off.
Muted first: the first frame and any on-screen text must hook without sound.
Use only facts the film can show or the user supplied. Never invent a number, record, price or superlative.
One visible physical action in the first shot. Avoid hand-and-tool contact the local motion model renders badly (flip, toss, catch, knead, whisk).

curiosity-gap.detect: \b(what happens|nothing on the outside|wait for|until|before you|here is how|watch (?:this|what)|hidden|inside|secret|reveal)\w*

patterns.spoken: {finished_result}. Here is how it started.
patterns.visual: Open on the finished texture in close view, then cut to the raw start.
patterns.motionSafe: slow push-in, steam or melt only

patterns.spoken: Nothing on the outside shows what is {hidden_part}.
patterns.visual: A closed, ordinary-looking shape in centre frame; something about it is slightly off.
patterns.motionSafe: static camera with one slow cut-open or crack

patterns.spoken: Watch the {focal_object} until the very end.
patterns.visual: Focal object centred, one clear state change promised by the framing.
patterns.motionSafe: slow dolly, one state change

patterns.spoken: You can skip {common_step} and still get {result}.
patterns.visual: The skipped step's tool sits unused in frame while the action proceeds.
patterns.motionSafe: single pour, spread or fold

patterns.spoken: Put the {usual_tool} down. This works better.
patterns.visual: The usual tool is set aside, the surprising one takes centre frame.
patterns.motionSafe: tool already in place, no hand contact change

patterns.spoken: One pass. Get it wrong and {cost}.
patterns.visual: Tense close view of the point of no return, e.g. liquid about to meet heat.
patterns.motionSafe: single pour into heat, side macro

patterns.spoken: {duration} before {deadline_event}.
patterns.visual: A visible countdown cue in the set (timer, melting ice, rising steam).
patterns.motionSafe: locked camera, melt or rise

patterns.spoken: {number} {unit}, and the {focal_object} looks like this.
patterns.visual: The counted items lined up in frame so the number is checkable by eye.
patterns.motionSafe: slow lateral slide along the row

patterns.spoken: Three things on the counter. Watch what they become.
patterns.visual: Exactly three ingredients on a clean surface, top-down.
patterns.motionSafe: static top-down, one ingredient moves

patterns.spoken: If your kitchen is small, this is for you.
patterns.visual: A compact counter, one pan, one board; relatable scale.
patterns.motionSafe: locked wide, one pan action

patterns.spoken: For anyone who wants {outcome} without the rush.
patterns.visual: Calm, warm light, steady pace implied by the framing.
patterns.motionSafe: slow pan, gentle steam

patterns.spoken: It started with just a {focal_object}.
patterns.visual: The plain starting state of the subject in its setting.
patterns.motionSafe: slow push-in on the starting state

patterns.spoken: Then {small_event} changed the plan.
patterns.visual: The first frame is just before the small event, framed so the viewer can see it coming.
patterns.motionSafe: one small physical event, locked camera

patterns.spoken: This is why yours {failure}.
patterns.visual: Show the failure state first, clearly and without distress.
patterns.motionSafe: slow macro of the failure, then the fix

patterns.spoken: One small mistake ruins {result}. Here is the fix.
patterns.visual: The mistaken setup in frame; the fix follows.
patterns.motionSafe: single corrective action, no hand-heavy work

patterns.spoken: Plain {focal_object}. Now watch it become {premium_result}.
patterns.visual: A deliberately plain first frame in the same set that the last frame will upgrade.
patterns.motionSafe: locked camera, texture or colour change

patterns.spoken: Raw and dull, until the heat hits.
patterns.visual: Raw ingredient on a hot surface, side macro.
patterns.motionSafe: side macro, sizzle and colour shift

patterns.spoken: Will the {focal_object} hold?
patterns.visual: The focal object under visible load or heat, close view.
patterns.motionSafe: slow push-in, one load or melt

patterns.spoken: What is hiding in the middle?
patterns.visual: Whole closed shape, centred.
patterns.motionSafe: static, then one clean cut or crack

patterns.spoken: Tonight's dinner, in {duration}.
patterns.visual: Evening light in the set, finished dish waiting in the background.
patterns.motionSafe: slow dolly, steam

patterns.spoken: This season's best {focal_object}, shown start to finish.
patterns.visual: A seasonal prop in frame that the viewer can identify without text.
patterns.motionSafe: slow pan across the seasonal prop

patterns.spoken: The one technique that changes {result}.
patterns.visual: The technique's key moment shown first, in close view, without hand rework.
patterns.motionSafe: single clear action, side macro

patterns.spoken: The rule: {rule}. Watch why.
patterns.visual: Two small states side by side so the rule is checkable by eye.
patterns.motionSafe: locked camera, two simultaneous states

antiPatterns: Any claim the film does not show (records, prices, health claims, 'banned', 'illegal')
Hook that needs sound to make sense
Hook whose action is a hand-and-tool contact the local model cannot render
